description:
DataLayer gives ChatGPT B2B data on 60 million companies and 300 million business contacts, so you can research accounts and find the right people without leaving the chat.

What you can do:
- Enrich a company from its domain: industry, headcount, revenue range, headquarters, funding, web traffic, Google ad spend and employee growth.
- See a company's tech stack across 16 categories, such as CRM, cloud, analytics and marketing automation.
- Find decision makers at a company, filtered by seniority and job function.
- Enrich or look up a person by work email, LinkedIn URL or name plus company domain, and get their title, seniority and contact details.
- Search companies by industry, country, size, tech stack, funding and growth, or search people by title, seniority, function and location.
- Check hiring activity by department and surface companies showing buying intent from traffic, ad spend, hiring and funding signals.

All 11 tools are read-only. They never create, change or delete anything in your DataLayer account.

Pricing: a free account includes 10 credits. Each successful match costs 1 credit, searches cost 1 credit per result, and intent signals cost 5 credits per result. Lookups that find nothing are free. Paid plans start at $49 a month for 1,000 credits.

You sign in with your DataLayer account through OAuth. You can revoke access at any time from your DataLayer dashboard.
